text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Malaysia's state-run Universiti Malaya will be corporatised by January 1, 1998, Education Minister Najib Tun Razak said.
-- Farlim Group is planning to launch an international hotel and clubhouse projects in Quanzhou in China.

-- Trenergy (M) Bhd expects to become a leading local supplier of services to the oil and gas industry by the year 2000. Its chairman Salehuddin Hashim said the company's market capitalisation would have risen five times to $1.0 billion due to fresh injection of capital.

-- Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said in Budapest that the Multimedia Super Corridor project just outside Kuala Lumpur will not only serve as an experimental base for multimedia companies, but will also see tests being conducted in real-life society and electronic government.
-- The Utama Banking Group, seeking a listing of its shares, said it will inject additional capital into its subsidiaries after the listing.
